batch: JoeWare UserDump, DNSSrvRec and ELDLLEx version-list reconciliation

versionList.limitation: Publisher MD5/SHA-1 rows do not identify or verify an acquired ZIP archive or its executable member bytes.

UserDumpProductPage.freshness: The web reader returned an official cached page, crawled approximately eight months earlier.
facts: Current Version says 1.01.00 dated 2001-01-28, matching the version-list digits/date after leading-zero normalization.
Version History lists 2.02.00 for the same date; this remains a source-page inconsistency.
The page describes enumerating user account status fields from an NT-based system and lists Windows NT, Windows 2000, Windows Server 2003 and Windows XP only. These are not RIDE support declarations.

JoeWareFreeToolsPage.freshness: The web reader returned the publisher's official page crawled the previous day.
facts: Describes DNSSrvRec as a command-line user utility to add/remove arbitrary DNS SRV records.
Describes ELDLLEx as two DLLs for customized event logging and message IDs below 200.
Its compatibility matrix contains historical Windows releases only and does not establish Windows 11 support.

productPageRecheck.DNSSrvRec: Official product page fetch returned a cache miss; no current page details were obtained.
productPageRecheck.ELDLLEx: Official product page fetch returned a cache miss; no current page details were obtained.

resolved: The UserDump current-version field matches the version-list version/date; the remaining 2.02.00 history entry is retained as an inconsistency.
DNSSrvRec and ELDLLEx version-list rows and their digest availability are recorded for exact-archive comparison.
partial: No exact archive, SHA-256, member identity or Windows 11 behavior was verified.
